rules.biological_truth: Only source-authenticated real observations, support and independent criteria can qualify a human biological state. Controller-only planted truth applies to simulation, never humans.
rules.selection: All rows are questions/hypotheses; no ranking, target winner, C1-C6 PASS or evidence threshold is selected.
rules.masking: Freeze the exact measured-query address, q-value exclusion, source support and teacher/student observation-right maps BEFORE inspecting human decision outcomes.
rules.comparison: Start with zero-update forward-only donor-disjoint baselines; generic-cell, address-identity, query-value, operator/depth and shuffled-condition controls; test full-versus-partial RNA information recoverability.
rules.cross_modal: ATAC accessibility, motif hits and predicted E2G links are distinct from TF occupancy or perturbation; same-nucleus versus separate-nucleus pairing must not be conflated.
rules.perturbation: Interventional evidence requires source guide/target/barcode identity, independent biological replicate units and real observed contrasts; simulated deltas never qualify an experimental effect.
rules.measurements: Assayed-but-undetected zero is not structurally unmeasured. Raw integer count/depth reference must be separately authenticated.
rules.eligibility: Donor/source/technology/population support and held-out evaluation; failures or inadequate replication produce NOT_ESTIMABLE rather than PASS.
